items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee (Rudy Van Gelder) does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Al Collins is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: There was a radio disc jockey in New York City called Al Collins. Collins on a Cloud was the name of his program, everyday in the afternoon. It was wonderful; it was very cool, nice music. It was a popular program. And one of the songs that Joe Mooney did, it was, “Will Be Together Again.” That got quite popular, everybody loved it, and he used that as the background for talking between the albums, between the records.
So you heard that on the radio?
